node.statement: Fix z with ||z||<(1-c)r. Choose rho with 0<rho<r and ||z||<(1-c)rho, let K={h in X:||h||<=rho}, and define T(h)=z+h-g(h). For h,k in K the secant-error hypothesis gives ||T(h)-T(k)||<=c||h-k||. Taking k=0 and g(0)=0 gives ||h-g(h)||<=c||h||, hence ||T(h)||<=||z||+c rho<rho; thus T maps the complete closed ball K into itself and is a contraction.
